title: The drunk trombonist at Loew's State on Christmas 1924
summary: Teroy gets drunk on stage wine, so the band props him between trumpets, gives him coffee, and hides it from the audience.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Well, the Christmas before we left. It was Christmas in 1924, we were down at Loew's State. We played Loew's State for Christmas. We doubled at the theater, the Loew's State. And the stage director, the stage manager, had some good muscatel wine. So, we was all celebrating for Christmas. "Merry Christmas", and we'd drink. And Teroy drank too much wine, of the wine. Now, so when it was time for the show he said, "Twenty, fifteen minutes." And we were trying to get Teroy together. Teroy -- cause he was sweet. And Teroy wasn't a rummy. He didn't know how to gauge himself. So now, here he sits up on the stage. You've never seen a band set up like this -- in Loew's State, too -- never seen a band set up like this. Each trumpet was on each side of him. Because we had to lock their legs into his. Because if he had tried to pick up a mute or anything, he would have stumbled over on the stage, you see?
Now, he's sitting there. So we tell him,

"Well, play when you feel like it." As soon as we got -- before we went on, we were pumping black coffee into him. And he sat there on the stage and I guess the people in the audience said, "What a queer setup that is." The trombone between the two trumpets. But then, in the other setup, he would have dropped something and caused the public to know. But do you know, we got away with it. They never realized that he was REALLY as drunk as he was. And we didn't dare to move him until the curtain came down. And then two guys got on each arm of him, the two trumpet players, and we took him on upstairs to the dressing room. Well, that was the funniest thing that ever happened. But the whole time I couldn't play nothing for watching him. Because one mistake, and we'd ruin it.
